title: No favicon is declared
detail: The document declares no <link rel="icon">. Browsers fall back to /favicon.ico only if the server happens to serve one; nothing is guaranteed, no resolution is specified, and tab strips, bookmarks, history and search results have no icon to show.
remedy: Add <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml"> plus a 32x32 PNG fallback to <head>.
